[[Opal Crystal]]s are tier 5 [[gemstone]]s that grant [[precision]], [[ferocity]], and [[power]] when applied. They can be found in [[chest]]s and [[container]]s or be dropped by creatures associated with air or electricity, such as [[Air Elemental|air elementals]], [[Dust Mites|dust mites]], and [[titan]]spawn of [[Decima, the Stormsinger]].
